title: tragopyrum polygamum
intro: Tragopyrum polygamum, commonly known as Bok Choy or Chinese Chard, is a type of leafy green vegetable belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Tragopyrum polygamum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
